document.about: LAPP innovation catalogue, spring 2026 (36 pages). Its product pages share one template: box headings and the close of a standard description stand at the same place on page after page, and a thumb index runs down the side margin.

notes: 2026-11-25 (#276): a QR code's modules, small drawn squares, stood level with the caption beside it and were taken as bullets: its lines read as list items. A drawing's dots crowd one another; a list's bullets stand a line apart.

checks.issue: #276: the caption beside each QR code was two list items.

element.text: Scan the QR code to view all available variants, technical data, datasheets, as well as suitable accessories and comparable products - including current availability directly in our online shop
